title: Evidence item
description: A single piece of evidence for Christian presence: an inscription, papyrus, literary passage, council subscription, or archaeological feature. One file per item under data/evidence/, named <id>.json.

id.description: Stable slug. Must equal the filename without .json; checked by validate.ts.

label.description: One-line identification, e.g. 'Ignatius of Antioch addresses the church at Ephesus'.

evidence_type.$comment: Allowed values and their quality grades live in schema/vocab/evidence-type.json; membership is checked by validate.ts, not by enum, so the vocabulary stays the single source of truth.

pleiades_uri.description: The Pleiades place URI. This project maintains no coordinates; they are joined from the Pleiades dump at build time.

note.description: For region_only and unlocated places: what is actually known about the location. validate.ts requires it for those two certainty values.

dateRange.$comment: There is deliberately no single 'date' field. A point date is expressed as not_before == not_after.

year.$comment: ISO 8601 / astronomical year numbering: 1 BCE is 0, 2 BCE is -1. Bounds are a sanity check, not the project scope.

primary.description: The primary source(s): the edition or corpus entry for documents, the passage for literary texts.

secondary.description: Modern scholarship supporting the dating or interpretation.

cite.description: Human-readable citation with locus, e.g. 'Ignatius, Eph. 1.3' or 'SEG 30.1479'.

bibkey.description: Key into data/sources/bibliography.bib; existence is checked by validate.ts.
